text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastGames(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
SportingEvent(summerOlympicGames) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastGames(lastSummerOlympicGames) ∧ Location(lastSummerOlympicGames, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, lastSummerOlympicGames) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
